outline: This course introduces fundamental concepts in Materials Science & Engineering. You will learn about the material structure, how structure dictates properties and how processing can change the structures.
schedule:
Week 1  course introduction.
week 2 Introduction to Materials Science and Engineering (Chapter 1)
week 3 Atomic Structure and Interatomic Bonding (Chapter 2)
week 4 Atomic Structure and Interatomic Bonding / Fundamentals of Crystallography (Chapter 3)
week 5 Fundamentals of Crystallography (Chapter 3)
week 6 The Structure of Crystalline Solids (Chapter 4)
week 7 The Structure of Crystalline Solids (Chapter 4)
week 8 Imperfections in Solids (Chapter 6)

week 9 mid-term

week 10 Imperfections in Solids (Chapter 6) / Diffusion (Chapter 7)
week 11 Diffusion (Chapter 7)
week 12 Diffusion (Chapter 7) / Mechanical Properties of Metals (Chapter 8)
week 13 Mechanical Properties of Metals (Chapter 8)
week 14 Dislocations and Strengthening Mechanism (Chapter 9)
week 15 Dislocations and Strengthening Mechanism (Chapter 9) / Failure (Chapter 10)
week 16 final exam

flexible_learning.content:
先進材料最新研究文獻研讀，學生需閱讀近五年國際期刊一篇之研究論文，分析材料設計理念、製程技術、特性及應用，並整理成書面報告繳交。
以下為建議期刊：Nature Energy, Nature Materials, Nature Physics, Nature Photonics, Nature Nanotechnology, Energy & Environmental Science, Journal of Materials Chemistry A, Science, Science Advances, Nano Letters, JACS, ACS Nano, ACS Energy Letters,  ACS Materials Letters, Advanced Materials, Advanced Energy Materials, Advanced Functional Materials, Advanced Science, Progress in Materials Science, Materials Today.
flexible_learning.outcome: 培養文獻閱讀、資料分析、科學表達及獨立思考能力，提升對材料與應用最新研究發展之理解。
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: 書面報告視為一次作業
